Title: Verify admin can create a new user via the Add User form
Description: This test case aims to verify admin can create a new user via the add user form.
Steps: 1. Log in to the application with admin credentials. 2. Navigate to the Users page. 3. Click the Add User button. 4. Fill in Full Name, Phone, and Email fields. 5. Select a Job Function from the dropdown. 6. Select an Assigned Role from the dropdown. 7. Select an Assigned Company from the dropdown. 8. Click the Create User button.
Outcome: 1. Login is successful and the dashboard loads. 2. The Users page loads with the user table. 3. The Create User dialog opens. 4-7. All fields are filled with valid data. 8. The dialog closes and the new user appears in the users table.
Preconditions: User must be logged in with admin or Super Admin role.

Title: Verify new user receives account verification email after admin creates the account
Description: This test case aims to verify new user receives account verification email after admin creates the account.
Steps: 1. Admin creates a new user with a MailSlurp inbox email address. 2. Wait for the email to arrive in the inbox (up to 45 seconds).
Outcome: 1. The user is created successfully. 2. An email is received with a subject containing "verify", "welcome", or "confirm".
Preconditions: A MailSlurp inbox must be created before the test. Admin must have created the user in a previous step.

Title: Verify new user receives a password setup email after admin creates the account
Description: This test case aims to verify new user receives a password setup email after admin creates the account.
Steps: 1. Admin creates a new user with a MailSlurp inbox email address. 2. Wait for a second email to arrive in the inbox (up to 45 seconds). 3. Check the email subject and body for password-related content.
Outcome: 1. The user is created successfully. 2-3. An email is received whose subject or body contains the word "password".
Preconditions: A MailSlurp inbox must be created before the test. Admin must have created the user in a previous step.

Title: Verify new user can set a password via the link received in the email
Description: This test case aims to verify new user can set a password via the link received in the email.
Steps: 1. Open the password setup email from the MailSlurp inbox. 2. Extract the password reset/setup link from the email body. 3. Navigate to the link. 4. Enter a new password in the password field. 5. Confirm the new password if a confirmation field is present. 6. Click the Submit button.
Outcome: 1. The email is received with a valid link. 2. The link is extracted from the email body. 3. The Auth0 password reset page loads. 4-5. The new password is entered. 6. The password is set successfully.
Preconditions: Password setup email must have been received in the previous step.

Title: Verify new user can log in with the newly set password
Description: This test case aims to verify new user can log in with the newly set password.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the login page. 2. Enter the new user email address in the Email field. 3. Enter the newly set password in the Password field. 4. Click the Sign in button.
Outcome: 1. The login page loads with Email and Password fields visible. 2. The email is entered. 3. The password is entered. 4. The user is authenticated and redirected away from the login page.
Preconditions: New user must have completed the password setup step.

Title: Verify new user accesses the dashboard after logging in
Description: This test case aims to verify new user accesses the dashboard after logging in.
Steps: 1. Log in with the new user credentials. 2. Observe the page that loads after successful authentication.
Outcome: 1. Login completes successfully. 2. The home dashboard is displayed showing the greeting, New Project button, New Order button, and order stats.
Preconditions: New user must have a role with dashboard access (e.g. Reader). New user must have completed password setup.
